meta.title: Graceful inject
meta.description: Two pluggable injection features, each with its own switch: resume (after DSH exits mid-turn — crash, kill, or shutdown timeout — the interrupted session resumes automatically with a marked "continue"; on host startup the plugin also scans sessions that were running when the previous process exited and takes them over in the background, no click required) and supervise (a stopwatch button in the session header that interrupts the current step, injects "report the current progress", then queues a follow-up turn that finishes the interrupted work).
